text: The checked virtual-folder tests spread nested reply chains over two folders, assert row-level histograms, and distinguish threaded from unthreaded flags. Their own comment says they are sanity tests of view-wrapper flags rather than a full threading/grouping implementation test. Bug 1939725 and D233248 have only saved selected summaries about an old double sort masking the typo. Keep that diagnosis qualified until the full discussion is read.
